scripts.clean:www: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path www) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force www }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path www | Out-Null"
scripts.copy:web: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item index.html www\index.html; Copy-Item css www\css -Recurse; Copy-Item js www\js -Recurse; Copy-Item resources www\resources -Recurse; Copy-Item config www\config -Recurse"
scripts.sync:android: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm run clean:www; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npm run copy:web; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npx cap sync android"
scripts.build:apk:debug: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm run sync:android; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug"
scripts.build:apk:release: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "npm run sync:android; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location android; .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease"
